name: ColorPicker
summary: A swatch with a name that opens a window to pick a colour: the area, the hue track and the hex field — or, as the swatches variation, a closed palette with the hex field.

a11y.apg: The trigger is a button named by the label and the colour's name; it opens a dialog named by the label. Inside: the ColorArea (a 2D slider), the hue Slider, the ColorSwatch options (a radio group) and the hex field. The hex is applied on Enter or when the field loses focus; text that is not a colour goes back to the colour before.
a11y.keyboardNote: Enter or Space on the trigger opens the window; Tab moves through the area, the hue track, the swatches and the hex field; each keeps its own keys; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. The name next to the swatch on the trigger ("Brand colour"). Names the trigger and the window.

props.name: value
props.description: The colour in hex (#rrggbb or #rgb), controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The starting colour when you do not control it.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called on release, on every key, when a swatch is chosen and when the hex is confirmed — the moment to save.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Ready colours, under the hue track; with variant="swatches", in place of the area. Without a label, each is named by the colour's name in the app's language.

props.name: variant
props.description: "swatches": the closed palette (ADR-0069, the "C") — only the swatches and the hex field.

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the window, built by you ("with fields", "with sliders"): the colour pieces without a value of their own — ColorArea, Slider with channel, ColorField — share the picker's colour.

props.name: name
props.description: Sends the colour with a form, as #rrggbb.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged onto the trigger, after the Aurea skin.
